criterion_evaluations.criterion:
Less than clinically meaningful improvement with at least TWO of the following (unless contraindicated):
- prescription strength analgesics, steroids, gabapentinoids, and/or nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs) for six (6) weeks
- provider-directed exercise program (prescribed by a physical therapist, chiropractic provider, osteopathic or allopathic physician) for six (6) weeks
- epidural steroid injection(s) or selective nerve root block(s) performed at the same level(s) as the requested surgery
- Plain x-rays of the cervical spine (including flexion/extension lateral views) have been performed
- MRI/CT shows neural structure compression at the requested level(s) that is concordant with the individual's symptoms and physical exam findings and that is caused by ANY of the following:
  - herniated disc(s) (retained disc material or a recurrent disc herniation)
  - synovial cyst or arachnoid cyst
  - central/lateral/foraminal stenosis
  - osteophytes

notes: The patient meets the criteria for Cigna ACDF (CMM-601) based on the clinical indication of Cervical Disc Herniation / Radiculopathy. The patient presents with significant daily pain, functional impairment, and objective physical exam findings consistent with radiculopathy (sensory deficit, positive Spurling's). Conservative management including physical therapy and medications has failed to provide clinically meaningful improvement. The patient meets the criteria for nicotine abstinence as confirmed by a negative cotinine test. The MRI/CT report confirms neural structure compression concordant with symptoms and physical exam findings, caused by herniated disc material (retained disc material or recurrent disc herniation), central/lateral/foraminal stenosis, osteophytes, synovial cyst or arachnoid cyst, cervical spinal cord compression, or cervical spinal stenosis. The patient does not have unmanaged mental health disorders or substance abuse disorder. Therefore, the system overall result is MET.
